title: A Drop for the Protocol
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: August Nystrom, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
